summary: Health verification after user-reported 502 Bad Gateway. Preview URL returns HTTP 200 and renders the React home page; no 502/Host Error anywhere. Supervisor reports backend, frontend, mongodb RUNNING. Core API sanity passed (GET /api/ healthy, /api/products=21 items, /api/categories=6, /api/store/info OK). Admin login (admin@ambajogai.com) returns a 232-char JWT and /api/admin/dashboard returns 200 with full payload. Frontend routes /, /products, /login, /cart all render with zero console errors and zero 5xx network responses. Full existing regression suite re-run: 49/49 passed.
seed_data_creation: None new; startup seed data loaded normally (logs show 'Seed data loaded.')
context_for_next_testing_agent: 502 was transient host-side; no code change needed. Backend logs clean (only uvicorn reload notices), frontend logs only webpack deprecation warnings. 49-case pytest suite is green and is the regression baseline.
rca_of_the_issue: No reproducible defect. The 502 Bad Gateway was a transient Kubernetes ingress/host-side condition; the container has since restarted (backend uptime fresh) and all services are healthy. No application-level cause found in backend.err.log or frontend.err.log.
